cohort: 800 pregnant women in Gaza, with 400 receiving preconception care and 400 controls
finding: While preconception care may promote positive maternal outcomes, further improvements are needed in targeting recipients of service, improving staff communication, informing and counselling prospective mothers, ensuring compliance with technical instructions, and strengthening monitoring and supervision.
mod_finding: The percentage of women who delivered via caesarean section was higher in the preconception care group (25%) compared to the control group (18%).
birth_weight: Mean birthweight was 3274.5 g among recipients of preconception care and 3225.4 g among non-recipients (p=0.2).
